whats this rba rate hike thing

Ah, the ol' RBA rate hike drama. The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) sometimes decides to increase interest rates. This usually happens when they're trying to keep inflation in check or cool down a hot economy. 

Basically, if the rates go up, borrowing money gets more expensive, which can slow down spending and investment. It's a bit of a juggling act to keep the economy stable without putting too much pressure on mortgage holders and other borrowers. Seems like someone's predicting a rate hike could be on the cards at their next meeting. Fun times!
